neighbours.label: a scope adjective that places something inside versus outside a domain (domestic, internal, personal, public, central) modifying a following noun
fire: Analysts expect the domestic market to recover before exports do.
The memo was meant only for internal review by the board.
He refused to discuss his personal life with reporters.
Officials said the public sector would see modest pay rises.
Most of the funding goes to central administration in the capital.
Rising costs hit domestic airlines harder than foreign carriers.
The audit uncovered several internal control weaknesses.
Voters care more about personal safety than about trade policy.
quiet: Analysts expect the housing market to recover before exports do.
The memo was meant only for careful review by the board.
He refused to discuss his new film with reporters.
Officials said the nursing staff would see modest pay rises.
Most of the funding goes to road repairs in the capital.
Rising costs hit smaller airlines harder than larger carriers.
The audit uncovered several accounting errors in the ledger.
Voters care more about rising rents than about trade policy.

notes: Weak pole (max 5.3); probes of domestic/internal/personal all stayed near 0.1 of max. Best guess from the card; expected to fail.
